shared_elements: paired symmetrical elements flanking a central axis
banded or panelled register of repeated signs
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow, schematic curvilinear relief with scroll/volute forms, concentric discs and paired symmetrical elements arranged around a central axis, and both include a band of repeated blocky signs at one edge, which is a moderately specific shared vocabulary. However, A is a flat panel entirely covered by an abstract interlocking scroll composition, while B is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders and torso on which pendant ornaments, a central disc pendant and a belt-like band are laid out in bodily positions — the organising scheme of the depicted content is quite different.
